messages:
Jo Chen (CEO): Quick sync follow-up from todays all-hands security block. We got questions on SOC2 evidence automation, ISO schedule, BYOK pilot timing, VPC/Privatelink checklist, and how audit logs are delivered for Private installs. Who can volunteer owners and short deadlines so Sales/CS can respond to prospects?

Ava (Security): I can own SOC2 evidence automation (collector + index). Plan: prototype auto-harvest for runbooks/screenshots and a manual QA step. Need Platform for log hashes and Legal for attest text.

Liam (Infra): Ill draft the VPC/privatelink checklist (network diagram, flow logs, private DNS, routing table examples). Will include terraform snippet and minimal port matrix. ETA: 2004568200 (Friday noon). Snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_flow_log" "redwood_private" {
  log_group_name = "/redwood/private/flow"
  traffic_type   = "ALL"
}
```

Priya (Legal): For SOC2/ISO evidence we need owner per control and proof artifacts named consistently. Also flag any customer wording that claims EU-only custody; needs Privacy review.

Nina (Privacy): Confirming: any promise of EU-only custody must map to region-bound key storage + EU bucket + DPA amendment. Also proposal: before export to customer buckets, we should redact PII fields in traces. Will propose anonymization rules.

Diego (Platform): Platform notes: (1) Audit-export API exists as prototype, we should harden auth and add signed job receipts; (2) BYOK pilot: need a small set of customers and KMS/HSM test vectors before we go GA. Ill open a tech ticket COM-700 and attach the API spec. ETA for initial export SLA doc: 2004568800 (Mon).

Ava (Security): Retention proposal: default 90d for full request bodies, 365d for metadata/audit events. Offer contract-extensible retention for enterprise (>=3 years) subject to Privacy sign-off.

Jo Chen (CEO): Sounds good. Can we also include a one-paragraph customer-facing explanation of how BYOK rotation avoids downtime? Sales needs it for RFPs.

Diego (Platform): Will add a short FAQ and sample CLI: ```bash
redwoodctl audit-export --job-id 12345 --bucket gs://customer-eu-bucket --region europe-west1
```

ETA for CLI examples: 2004568600 (Sun night).

Liam (Infra): On HSM: for on-prem/private HSM integration, we need VINs and an approved customer test plan. Ill coordinate with Ops to get the NDA flow started.

Priya (Legal): Ill review the SOC2 tracker language and the FAQ by 2004569000 (Tue morning). Please route drafts to the compliance workspace.

Ava (Security): Owner assignments: SOC2 automation + tracker = Ava. VPC checklist = Liam. Export SLA + CLI = Diego. Privacy/anonymization = Nina. Deadlines in the workspace; Ill post links.

ops-bot: Transcript and recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/2004567890 (redwood SSO).

Jo Chen (CEO): Thanks. Please escalate any cross-team blockers to #leadership-ops. Ill join the Tuesday 10am sync if any exec-level unblock is needed.

Ava (Security): Will post the SOC2 tracker link here when ready. :thumbsup:
